name: Kansai International Airport

runway.v: two runways: A 3,500 m x 60 m and B 4,000 m x 60 m
runway.quote: B (2nd) runway • Length: 4,000 m • Width: 60 m

handling.v: Premium Gate Tamayura, a dedicated business jet facility in Terminal 2, with its own CIQ and security; open all day
handling.quote: Premium Gate Tamayura is a dedicated business jet facility located within KIX Terminal 2 Building. ... Operation time All day

curfew.v: no curfew, says the airport operator's page for airlines (page undated)
curfew.quote: Airport on artificial islands 5km away from the cities →No curfew.

slots.v: Level 3 (coordinated) airport (level 2 until the Summer 2021 season); slots are coordinated by Japan Schedule Coordination (JSC). MLIT asks foreign business-jet operators to finish slot and stand coordination before applying for the flight permit
slots.quote: JSC is in charge of Narita International Airport (NRT), Tokyo International Airport (Haneda) (HND), Fukuoka Airport (FUK) and Kansai International Airport (KIX) for level 3 aiport, and New Chitose Airport (CTS) for level 2 airport. (note) Kansai International Airport is desingated as level 2 airport until S21.

before_permit.v: finish slot and stand coordination at the airport before applying for the MLIT permit
before_permit.quote: 使用空港のスロット、スポット等の調整を終えておくこと。

missing: customs (Tamayura has dedicated CIQ and is open all day, but CIQ hours are not stated)
slot lead time and business-jet rules (JSC FAQ covers airline schedules only)
